### Connecting to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth

- **Wi-Fi:** Swipe down the notification shade and tap the Wi-Fi icon to toggle on/off. Long press opens Wi-Fi settings.
- **Bluetooth:** Swipe down and tap Bluetooth icon to toggle. Long press to pair with devices.
- Pairing steps:
  1. Turn on Bluetooth on both devices.
  2. On Realme X, go to Settings > Bluetooth.
  3. Select the device to pair.
  4. Confirm pairing code if prompted.

### Battery and Charging

- Use the included SuperVOOC charger for fast charging.
- To charge, connect the USB Type-C cable to the phone and plug the charger into a power outlet.
- The battery icon in the status bar shows charging status.
- Enable power saving modes via Settings > Battery to extend battery life.

---

## Advanced Features

Explore some of the Realme X's advanced functionalities to enhance your experience:

### 1. Under-Display Fingerprint Sensor

- Register fingerprints via Settings > Security > Fingerprint.
- Unlock your device by placing your registered finger on the designated area of the display.

### 2. Pop-Up Front Camera

### 3. Realme UI Customization

### 4. Game Space

### 5. Clone Apps

- Use App Cloner to run multiple accounts on the same app (e.g., WhatsApp).

### 6. Split Screen Mode

- Open recent apps.
- Tap the split screen icon on the app window or drag the app to the top of the screen.
- Select the second app to use both simultaneously.

### 7. Smart Sidebar

- Swipe from the edge of the screen to open Smart Sidebar.
- Add frequently used apps and tools for quick access.

---

## Maintenance and Care

Proper care will help maintain the performance and longevity of your Realme X.

### Cleaning

- Use a soft, dry, or slightly damp microfiber cloth to clean the screen and body.
- Avoid using abrasive materials or harsh chemicals like alcohol, ammonia, or solvents.

### Battery Care

- Avoid exposing the device to extreme temperatures (below 0°C or above 35°C).
- Do not overcharge; unplug the charger once the battery reaches 100%.
- Use only the original charger and cable supplied.
- Avoid using the phone extensively while charging to reduce heat buildup.

### Physical Protection

- Use the included protective case to prevent scratches and minor drops.
- Consider applying an additional screen protector if desired.
- Avoid exposing the device to water or moisture; Realme X is not rated as waterproof.

### Software Updates

- Regularly check for system updates via Settings > Software Updates.
- Keeping your device updated ensures security patches and performance improvements.

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem                      | Possible Cause                                         | Solution                                                                                   |
|------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Device does not turn on       | Battery drained or system freeze                       | Charge the device for at least 30 minutes, then press and hold the power button for 10 seconds to force restart. |
| Screen unresponsive           | Software glitch or physical damage                      | Restart the device. If problem persists, back up data and perform a factory reset.          |
| Cannot insert SIM card        | Incorrect SIM tray placement or damaged SIM            | Remove SIM tray, check SIM orientation, reinsert carefully. Use a different SIM to test.    |
| No mobile network signal      | SIM card not activated or network outage                | Toggle Airplane mode on/off, restart device, check SIM card status with carrier.            |
| Camera app crashes            | Software bug or insufficient memory                     | Clear camera app cache (Settings > Apps > Camera > Storage > Clear Cache). Restart device.  |
| Battery drains quickly        | Background apps or old battery                            | Close unused apps, disable unnecessary connectivity (Bluetooth/Wi-Fi), reduce screen brightness. Consider battery replacement if old. |
| Fingerprint sensor not working| Dirty sensor or unregistered fingerprint                  | Clean screen area, re-register fingerprints via Settings > Security > Fingerprint.          |
| Unable to connect to Wi-Fi    | Incorrect password or router issues                      | Forget network and reconnect, restart router, move closer to Wi-Fi source.                  |
| Phone overheating             | Intensive apps running or environmental heat             | Close background apps, reduce screen brightness, avoid charging while using heavy apps.     |
| Pop-up front camera stuck     | Mechanical obstruction or software freeze                | Restart device. If camera remains stuck, contact Realme Service Center for repair.          |

## Safety Information

Your safety and the safety of others are important to Realme. Please read these precautions carefully before using your Realme X.

- Do not disassemble or modify the phone yourself.
- Avoid dropping or exposing the phone to strong impacts.
- Keep the device away from water and moisture to prevent damage.
- Use only authorized accessories and chargers.
- Do not use the phone in environments with flammable gases or explosive materials.

### Battery Safety

- Handle the battery with care; do not puncture or expose it to heat.
- If the battery leaks or emits unusual odor, avoid contact and seek professional help.

### Health Considerations

- Limit exposure to radio frequency energy by using hands-free options or speakerphone.
- Avoid prolonged skin contact with the device when on.
- Keep the device out of reach of young children.
- If you have an implanted pacemaker or similar medical device, keep the phone at least 15 cm away.

### Driving Safety

- Do not use the phone while driving unless hands-free.
- Obey local laws regarding mobile device use in vehicles.

### Environmental Conditions

- Do not expose the device to extreme temperatures or direct sunlight.
- Avoid using the device in dusty or dirty environments.

## Warranty and Support

### Warranty

- The Realme X comes with a **1-month limited warranty** covering manufacturing defects.
- The warranty does **not** cover:
  - Physical damage (cracks, dents, water damage)
  - Damage caused by unauthorized repairs or modifications
  - Battery wear and tear after normal use
  - Software issues caused by third-party apps

### Support

For assistance with your Realme X, please use one of the following methods:

- **Customer Service Hotline:** Available Monday to Friday, 9 AM - 6 PM (local time).
- **Official Realme Website:** Visit [https://www.realme.com](https://www.realme.com) for FAQs, software updates, and support articles.
- **Authorized Service Centers:** Find the nearest Realme service center for repairs.
- **Email Support:** Send detailed inquiries to support@realme.com.

### Shipping and Returns

- Orders ship within 3-5 business days from the date of purchase.
- Realme X has **no return policy**; please ensure your purchase decision carefully.
- For warranty claims, proof of purchase is required.

---

## FAQ

**Q1: How do I take a screenshot on the Realme X?**  
A: To take a screenshot, press the **Power** button and **Volume Down** button simultaneously for 1-2 seconds until you see a screen capture animation. Alternatively, you can swipe down from the top to open Quick Settings and tap the Screenshot icon.

**Q2: Can I expand the storage on the Realme X?**  
A: Yes, the Realme X supports microSD cards up to 256GB, which you can insert along with your SIM cards in the SIM tray.

**Q3: How do I enable Face Unlock?**  
A: Go to **Settings > Security > Face Unlock**, follow the prompts to scan your face using the pop-up front camera. Ensure you are in a well-lit environment for best results.

**Q4: What should I do if the pop-up front camera does not rise?**  
A: Restart your phone first. If the problem persists, check for debris around the camera slot. If unresolved, contact Realme support as the mechanism may require professional repair.

**Q5: How do I update the software on my Realme X?**  
A: Navigate to **Settings > Software Updates** and tap **Check for updates**. If an update is available, follow on-screen instructions to download and install.

**Q6: How do I reset my Realme X to factory settings?**  
A: Backup your data first. Then go to **Settings > Additional Settings > Backup & Reset > Factory Data Reset**, and confirm. This will erase all personal data and return the device to original state.

**Q7: Why is my battery draining fast?**  
A: Battery drain can be caused by background apps, high screen brightness, or poor network signal. Close unused apps, adjust brightness, enable battery saver mode, and turn off unnecessary connections.

**Q8: Is the Realme X waterproof?**  
A: No, the Realme X does not have an official IP rating and should be kept away from water and moisture.

**Q9: How do I use dual apps on the Realme X?**  
A: Go to **Settings > Clone Apps**, then toggle the apps you want to duplicate. You can then use two accounts simultaneously for supported apps.

**Q10: How do I enable Dark Mode?**  
A: Open **Settings > Display & Brightness**, and toggle on **Dark Mode**. This changes system colors to darker tones to reduce eye strain and save battery.

---

Thank you for choosing Realme X. We hope this guide helps you enjoy your new smartphone to its fullest potential. For additional support, please contact Realme customer service.

**1. What is the exact weight of the Realme XT?**  
The official weight of the Realme XT is approximately 183 grams. The 3 grams mentioned in some documents is a typographical error.

**2. Does the Realme XT support 5G networks?**  
No, the Realme XT supports 4G LTE networks but is not compatible with 5G.

**3. Can I expand the storage on the Realme XT?**  
Yes, the device supports microSD cards up to 256GB, allowing you to expand storage beyond the built-in 128GB.

**4. How do I enable the in-display fingerprint sensor?**  
Go to **Settings > Security > Fingerprint**, then follow the on-screen instructions to register your fingerprint.

**5. What camera features does the Realme XT offer for low-light photography?**  
The phone includes Nightscape mode, which uses multi-frame processing to enhance photos taken in low light for clearer and brighter images.

**6. Is the Realme XT water-resistant?**  
No, the Realme XT does not have an official IP rating for water or dust resistance. Avoid exposure to liquids.

**7. How long does the battery typically last on a full charge?**  
Under moderate usage, the 4000mAh battery can last up to a full day. Usage patterns and settings affect battery life.

**8. Can I use two SIM cards and a microSD card simultaneously?**  
Yes, the SIM tray supports two nano-SIM cards and one microSD card at the same time.

**9. How do I reset the Realme XT to factory settings?**  
Go to **Settings > Additional Settings > Backup & Reset > Factory Data Reset**, then follow prompts to erase all data and restore factory defaults.

**10. Does the Realme XT support fast charging?**  
Yes, it supports VOOC Flash Charge 3.0 technology with the included 20W charger for faster charging times.

**11. How can I update the software on my Realme XT?**  
Navigate to **Settings > Software Update** and tap **Check for Updates**. Download and install any available updates.

**12. What should I do if my Realme XT becomes unresponsive?**  
Perform a force restart by pressing and holding the power button and volume down button simultaneously for about 10 seconds.

**13. Can I customize the user interface on the Realme XT?**  
Yes, the Realme UI allows for customization of themes, wallpapers, icon packs, and system animations.

**14. How do I contact Realme customer support?**  
You can contact support via the official website, email support@realme.com, or through the customer service hotline listed on your local Realme site.

---

Thank you for choosing Realme XT. We hope this guide helps you enjoy your device to the fullest. For further assistance, please contact Realme support or visit the official website.

products.userGuide:
# Samsung Galaxy S10 User Guide

## Overview

The Samsung Galaxy S10 is a flagship smartphone that combines cutting-edge technology with sleek design and powerful performance. Featuring a vibrant 6.1-inch Dynamic AMOLED display, the Galaxy S10 delivers stunning visuals with deep blacks and vivid colors, perfect for media consumption, gaming, and daily tasks. Its versatile triple-camera system allows you to capture beautiful photos and videos in a variety of conditions, including ultra-wide shots and detailed close-ups.

Powered by a high-performance processor and ample RAM, the Galaxy S10 ensures smooth multitasking, fast app launches, and efficient battery usage. The device supports wireless charging and offers advanced security features including ultrasonic fingerprint scanning and facial recognition. With the Samsung Galaxy S10, you experience innovation and excellence in smartphone technology, making it a perfect companion for both work and leisure.

This user guide is designed to help you understand and utilize all the features of your Samsung Galaxy S10, from initial setup to troubleshooting common issues.

---

## What's in the Box

When you purchase your Samsung Galaxy S10, you will receive the following items in the package:

1. Samsung Galaxy S10 smartphone
2. USB Type-C charging cable
3. Fast wall charger adapter (15W)
4. AKG-tuned wired earbuds with multiple ear tip sizes
5. SIM card ejector tool
6. Quick start guide and warranty information booklet
7. USB Type-C to USB-A adapter (OTG adapter)
8. Protective clear case (may vary by region)

Make sure to check the box contents upon receipt to ensure all items are present and undamaged.

---

## Specifications

| Feature                  | Description                               |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| Display                  | 6.1-inch Dynamic AMOLED, 3040 x 1440 pixels (QHD+), Infinity-O display with punch-hole camera |
| Processor                | Exynos 9820 Octa-core (Global) / Qualcomm Snapdragon 855 (USA) |
| RAM                      | 8 GB                                      |
| Storage                  | 128 GB internal storage, expandable via microSD up to 512 GB |
| Rear Cameras             | Triple camera setup: 12 MP (wide, variable aperture f/1.5-f/2.4), 12 MP (telephoto, f/2.4), 16 MP (ultra-wide, f/2.2) |
| Front Camera             | 10 MP, Dual Pixel, f/1.9                 |
| Battery                  | 3400 mAh, supports Fast Charging (15W wired), Fast Wireless Charging 2.0, and Wireless PowerShare |
| Operating System         | Android 9.0 Pie (upgradable to Android 12 with One UI 4) |
| Dimensions (cm)          | 14.9 x 7.0 x 0.8 (Note: corrected from the original for realistic phone size) |
| Weight                   | 157 grams                                |
| Connectivity             | Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax), Bluetooth 5.0, NFC, USB Type-C 3.1, GPS, 4G LTE |
| Security Features        | Ultrasonic in-display fingerprint sensor, Face Recognition |
| Audio                    | Stereo speakers tuned by AKG, 3.5mm headphone jack |
| Water and Dust Resistance| IP68 certified (up to 1.5m for 30 minutes) |
| Colors Available         | Prism White, Prism Black, Prism Green, Prism Blue, Flamingo Pink |

*Note:* Dimensions and weight listed here reflect accurate device measurements instead of the package dimensions.

---

## Setup

Getting started with your Samsung Galaxy S10 is quick and easy. Follow these steps to set up your device:

### 1. Insert SIM Card and microSD Card (Optional)

- Locate the SIM card tray on the top edge of your device.
- Use the SIM ejector tool provided in the box to open the tray.
- Place your nano-SIM card into the tray with the gold contacts facing down.
- If you have a microSD card, place it in the tray alongside the SIM card.
- Carefully reinsert the tray into the phone until it clicks into place.

### 2. Power On the Device

- Press and hold the power button on the right side of the phone until the Samsung logo appears.
- The device will boot up to the welcome screen.

### 3. Initial Configuration

- Select your preferred language.
- Connect to a Wi-Fi network by selecting your network name and entering the password.
- Agree to the terms and conditions.
- Sign in to your Google account to access the Google Play Store and sync your data.
- Optionally, sign in to your Samsung account for additional features and cloud backup.

### 4. Set Up Security

- You will be prompted to set up security options including:
  - **Fingerprint Scanner**: Follow on-screen instructions to register your fingerprint using the ultrasonic in-display sensor.
  - **Face Recognition**: Set up facial recognition by positioning your face within the circle.
  - **PIN, Password, or Pattern**: Choose a backup method for unlocking your device.

### 5. Restore Data (Optional)

- If you have a previous Samsung or Android device, you can restore your apps, contacts, and settings using Samsung Smart Switch or Google backup.

### 6. Complete Setup

- Customize additional settings such as Google Assistant, Samsung Pay, and app permissions.
- You will be taken to the home screen, ready to use your Galaxy S10.

---

## Operation

This section covers everyday use of your Samsung Galaxy S10.

### Navigating the Interface

- **Home Screen**: The main screen where your apps and widgets are located.
- **Navigation Buttons**:
  - **Gesture Navigation (default)**: Swipe up from the bottom to go home, swipe up and hold for recent apps, swipe from left or right edge to go back.
  - **Button Navigation**: Optionally enable traditional buttons (Back, Home, Recent) via Settings > Display > Navigation bar.
- **Notification Panel**: Swipe down from the top to access notifications and quick settings.
- **Quick Settings**: Swipe down twice or swipe down with two fingers to see toggles like Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Flashlight, and Airplane Mode.

### Making Calls

1. Open the Phone app from the home screen or app drawer.
2. Use the keypad to dial a number or select a contact.
3. Tap the green call button.
4. During a call, you can use speakerphone, mute, add another call, or access the keypad.

### Sending Messages

1. Open the Messages app.
2. Tap the "+" or "Start chat" button.
3. Enter the recipient's phone number or select a contact.
4. Type your message and tap send.

### Using the Camera

- Open the Camera app from the home screen or lock screen shortcut.
- Swipe left or right to switch between modes: Photo, Video, Live Focus (portrait), Pro, Panorama, Slow-motion.
- Tap the shutter button to take a photo or start/stop video recording.
- Use the zoom slider to switch between ultra-wide, wide, and telephoto lenses.
- Access settings by tapping the gear icon to adjust resolution, timer, grid lines, and more.

### Charging Your Device

- Use the supplied USB Type-C cable and charger for optimal charging speed.
- Connect the charger to a power outlet and plug the USB cable into your phone.
- The Galaxy S10 supports Fast Charging and Fast Wireless Charging.
- You can also wirelessly charge compatible devices using Wireless PowerShare by enabling it in Quick Settings.

### Connecting to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth

- Go to Settings > Connections > Wi-Fi to select and connect to available networks.
- For Bluetooth, go to Settings > Connections > Bluetooth, toggle it on, and pair with devices such as headphones or car systems.

### Managing Apps

- Open the Google Play Store to download and update apps.
- To uninstall or disable apps, go to Settings > Apps, select the app, and choose Uninstall or Disable.
- Use Device Care in Settings to optimize performance, clear cache, and free up storage.

---

## Advanced Features

The Samsung Galaxy S10 offers several advanced features that enhance usability and productivity.

### Ultrasonic Fingerprint Scanner

- Located under the display, the ultrasonic fingerprint sensor reads your fingerprint in 3D, providing high security.
- Register multiple fingerprints for convenience.
- Works well even with wet or slightly dirty fingers.

### Wireless PowerShare

- Share your Galaxy S10's battery charge with other Qi-compatible devices.
- Enable Wireless PowerShare from the Quick Settings panel.
- Place the device you want to charge on the back of your Galaxy S10.
- Charging will start automatically.

### Samsung DeX

- Connect your Galaxy S10 to a monitor or TV via a USB-C to HDMI adapter or wirelessly.
- Samsung DeX transforms your phone into a desktop computing experience.
- Use a mouse and keyboard for enhanced productivity.
- Run multiple apps in resizable windows, just like on a PC.

### Bixby Voice Assistant

- Press the Bixby button or say “Hi Bixby” to activate.
- Use Bixby to open apps, set reminders, send messages, or control smart home devices.
- Customize Bixby routines to automate daily tasks based on time, location, or activity.

### Digital Wellbeing

- Monitor and manage your phone usage habits.
- Access Digital Wellbeing in Settings to set app timers, enable Focus mode, or view usage statistics.

### Camera Pro Mode

- Access Pro Mode from the Camera app for manual control of ISO, shutter speed, white balance, and focus.
- Capture professional-quality photos with fine adjustments.

### Secure Folder

- Create a separate encrypted folder to store sensitive apps, files, and data.
- Access via Settings > Biometrics and Security > Secure Folder.
- Secure Folder contents are protected by a separate authentication method.

---

## Maintenance and Care

Proper care will keep your Samsung Galaxy S10 functioning optimally for years.

### Cleaning

- Use a soft, lint-free cloth to clean the screen and back.
- Avoid using harsh chemicals, solvents, or abrasive materials.
- For stubborn smudges, slightly dampen the cloth with water or a screen-safe cleaner.

### Battery Care

- Avoid exposing your phone to extreme temperatures (below 0°C or above 35°C).
- Do not leave the phone charging overnight regularly to prolong battery lifespan.
- Use only Samsung-certified chargers and cables.
- Avoid letting the battery drain completely before charging.

### Physical Protection

- Use the included protective case or purchase one to prevent damage from drops.
- Consider applying a screen protector to guard against scratches.
- Keep the charging port and speaker grills free of dust and debris.

### Software Updates

- Regularly check for system and app updates in Settings > Software Update.
- Updates improve security, add features, and fix bugs.

### Storage Management

- Monitor available storage via Settings > Device Care > Storage.
- Delete unused apps, clear cache, or move media files to cloud storage or an SD card.

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem                             | Possible Cause                                 | Solution                                                                                      |
|-----------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Phone won't turn on                | Battery drained or software crash             | Charge the phone for at least 30 minutes, then press and hold the power button for 10 seconds to restart. |
| Screen unresponsive                | Software freeze or screen damage               | Force restart by holding Power + Volume Down for 10 seconds. If damaged, contact repair service. |
| Unable to connect to Wi-Fi        | Wi-Fi network issues or incorrect password    | Toggle Wi-Fi off and on, restart the router, forget and reconnect to the network with correct password. |
| Bluetooth won't pair               | Device compatibility or interference           | Restart both devices, ensure Bluetooth is enabled, and remove old pairings if necessary. |
| Camera app crashes or freezes     | Software glitch or insufficient memory         | Clear camera app cache via Settings > Apps > Camera > Storage > Clear Cache. Restart phone.  |
| Battery drains quickly             | Background apps, screen brightness, or old battery | Reduce screen brightness, close unused apps, disable unnecessary background activity, or enable power saving mode. |
| Fingerprint sensor not working     | Dirty sensor or wet fingers                     | Clean the screen gently, dry your fingers, re-register fingerprints in Settings.             |
| Phone overheating                  | Intensive apps running or environmental heat   | Close heavy apps, remove phone case temporarily, keep phone out of direct sunlight.          |

---

## Safety Information

Your safety and the safety of others are important when using your Samsung Galaxy S10. Please observe the following precautions:

- **Avoid Exposure to Water:** Although the Galaxy S10 is IP68 rated, it is not waterproof. Avoid prolonged exposure to water and do not submerge it intentionally.
- **Driving Safety:** Do not use your phone while driving unless using hands-free features.
- **Battery Safety:** Do not attempt to open or disassemble the battery. Only use Samsung-approved accessories and chargers.
- **Medical Devices:** Maintain a minimum distance of 15 cm (6 inches) between your phone and implanted medical devices such as pacemakers.
- **Radio Frequency Exposure:** The Galaxy S10 complies with RF exposure guidelines. Use the phone with proper accessories and hold it away from your body.
- **Hearing Safety:** Avoid listening at high volume levels to prevent hearing damage.
- **Device Usage:** Avoid using the phone in explosive environments or where electronic devices are prohibited.
- **Proper Disposal:** Dispose of your device and batteries according to local electronic waste regulations.

---

## Warranty and Support

- **Warranty:** The Samsung Galaxy S10 does not come with a manufacturer warranty.
- **Shipping:** Your device ships within 2 weeks of order confirmation.
- **Return Policy:** You may return the product within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, provided it is in original condition.
- **Technical Support:** For assistance, visit Samsung's official support website or contact Samsung customer care via phone or chat.
- **Repair Services:** Authorized Samsung service centers offer repair and maintenance services. Check the official site for authorized locations.
- **Software Updates:** Samsung regularly provides software updates for security and features. Ensure your device stays updated.

---

## FAQ

**Q1: How do I take a screenshot on the Galaxy S10?**  
**A:** To capture a screenshot, simultaneously press and hold the Power button and the Volume Down button for about 1-2 seconds. The screen will flash, and the screenshot will be saved to your Gallery in the Screenshots folder.

**Q2: Can I use the Galaxy S10 with wireless charging?**  
**A:** Yes, the Galaxy S10 supports Fast Wireless Charging 2.0. You can place the device on a compatible wireless charger to charge without cables. Additionally, you can use Wireless PowerShare to charge other devices.

**Q3: How do I extend battery life on my Galaxy S10?**  
**A:** You can extend battery life by lowering screen brightness, turning on power saving mode, closing unused apps, disabling unnecessary background processes, and turning off features like Bluetooth or Wi-Fi when not in use.

**Q4: Is the Galaxy S10 water-resistant?**  
**A:** Yes, it has an IP68 rating, meaning it is resistant to dust and can withstand immersion in up to 1.5 meters of freshwater for up to 30 minutes. Avoid saltwater and other liquids, as they may damage the device.

**Q5: How do I update my Galaxy S10 to the latest software?**  
**A:** Go to Settings > Software Update > Download and Install. If an update is available, follow the on-screen instructions to download and install it. Keep your device connected to Wi-Fi and charged during the process.

**Q6: Can I expand the storage on my Galaxy S10?**  
**A:** Yes, the Galaxy S10 supports microSD cards up to 512 GB. Insert the card into the SIM/microSD tray to expand your storage capacity.

**Q7: How do I reset my Galaxy S10 to factory settings?**  
**A:** Back up your data first. Then go to Settings > General Management > Reset > Factory Data Reset, and follow the prompts. This will erase all data and restore the phone to its original state.

**Q8: What should I do if my phone freezes or becomes unresponsive?**  
**A:** Perform a force restart by holding the Power and Volume Down buttons simultaneously for about 10 seconds until the device restarts. If issues persist, consider clearing the cache partition or performing a factory reset.

---

This concludes the Samsung Galaxy S10 User Guide. For further assistance, please contact Samsung Support or visit the official website. Enjoy your new Galaxy S10!

# Samsung Galaxy S7 User Guide

## Overview

The Samsung Galaxy S7 is a flagship smartphone that combines elegant design with powerful technology. Released by Samsung, this device is well-known for its high-resolution display, robust performance, and advanced camera capabilities. Whether you are a casual user or a tech enthusiast, the Galaxy S7 offers a smooth, intuitive experience backed by Samsung's renowned quality.

With a sleek, ergonomic design and a lightweight build, the Galaxy S7 fits comfortably in your hand and pocket. Its bright and vivid display makes viewing photos, videos, and apps a pleasure, while the powerful internal components ensure smooth multitasking and gaming. The device also includes features such as water resistance, fast charging, and expandable storage, making it versatile for everyday use.

This guide will walk you through everything you need to know about your Samsung Galaxy S7—from unboxing and setup to advanced features, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Whether you're a new user or need help with specific functions, this guide will serve as your go-to resource.

---

## What's in the Box

When you purchase the Samsung Galaxy S7, you will receive the following items:

1. **Samsung Galaxy S7 smartphone**  
   The main device, pre-installed with the Android operating system and Samsung's custom software.

| **Sensors**           | Fingerprint (front-mounted), Heart Rate sensor, Accelerometer, Gyro, Proximity, Compass, Barometer |

| **Warranty**          | 3 months                        |
| **Shipping**          | Ships in 3-5 business days       |
| **Return Policy**     | No returns accepted               |

## Setup

Getting started with your Samsung Galaxy S7 is straightforward. Follow these steps to set up your device and begin using it.

### 1. Insert SIM Card and microSD Card (Optional)

1. Locate the SIM card tray on the top edge of the phone.
2. Use the SIM ejector tool to open the tray by inserting it into the small hole and gently pushing.
3. Place your nano-SIM card into the designated slot. If you have a microSD card, insert it into the other slot.
4. Carefully reinsert the tray into the device until it clicks into place.

### 2. Power On the Device

1. Press and hold the **Power** button located on the right side of the phone for about 3 seconds.
2. Wait until the Samsung logo appears, signaling the device is booting up.

### 3. Initial Setup Wizard

1. Select your preferred language.
2. Connect to a Wi-Fi network by selecting your network and entering the password.
3. Sign in to your Google account to access Google services such as the Play Store, Gmail, and more.
4. Set up Samsung account (optional but recommended for Samsung cloud services and device tracking).
5. Configure security options such as screen lock (PIN, pattern, password) or fingerprint setup.
6. Review and accept Samsung's terms and conditions and privacy policy.

### 4. Restore or Transfer Data (Optional)

- You can restore apps and data from a previous Android device using Samsung Smart Switch or Google backup.
- Follow on-screen instructions to transfer contacts, messages, photos, and apps.

### 5. Complete Setup

- After initial configuration, you will be taken to the Home Screen.
- Your Galaxy S7 is now ready for use.

---

## Operation

This section explains basic operations for daily use of the Samsung Galaxy S7.

### Unlocking the Device

- **Fingerprint Scanner**: Place your registered finger on the physical home button to unlock quickly.
- **PIN/Pattern/Password**: Enter your security code if fingerprint is not set or after a restart.

### Navigating the Home Screen

- Swipe left or right to switch between home screen panels.
- Tap app icons to open applications.
- Press the **Home** button to return to the main home screen.
- Use the **Back** button (bottom right) to go to the previous screen.
- Press the **Recent Apps** button (bottom left) to view and switch between open apps.

### Making Calls

1. Tap the **Phone** app icon.
2. Use the dial pad or select a contact from the Favorites or Contacts tabs.
3. Tap the green phone icon to initiate a call.
4. During calls, you can mute the microphone, enable speakerphone, or add additional callers.

### Sending Messages

1. Open the **Messages** app.
2. Tap the "+" icon or "New message" button.
3. Enter the recipient's phone number or select a contact.
4. Type your message and tap the **Send** button.

### Using the Camera

- Launch the **Camera** app from the home screen or lock screen shortcut.
- Switch between rear and front cameras using the camera flip icon.
- Use modes like Auto, Pro, Panorama, Video, and Slow Motion.
- Tap the shutter button to take photos or record videos.

### Charging the Device

- Connect the USB cable to the wall charger and plug it into an electrical outlet.
- Connect the other end to the micro USB port located at the bottom of the device.
- The device supports fast charging; using the original charger is recommended for optimal charging speed.

### Adjusting Volume

- Use the physical volume buttons on the left side to increase or decrease volume.
- Press the **Volume Down** button during a call to mute.

### Connecting to Wi-Fi

1. Open **Settings**.
2. Tap **Wi-Fi**.
3. Select your network and enter the password.
4. Once connected, the Wi-Fi icon appears in the status bar.

### Bluetooth Pairing

1. Go to **Settings** > **Bluetooth**.
2. Toggle Bluetooth on.
3. Select the device you want to pair with from the list.
4. Confirm pairing by entering the PIN if required.

---

## Advanced Features

Samsung Galaxy S7 includes several advanced features designed to enhance your smartphone experience.

### 1. Always On Display

- Shows time, date, notifications, and battery status even when the screen is off.
- To enable: Go to **Settings** > **Display** > **Always On Display** and toggle it on.
- Customize what information is shown and the clock style.

### 2. Water and Dust Resistance

- The Galaxy S7 has IP68 certification, meaning it is water-resistant up to 1.5 meters for 30 minutes.
- You can safely use it in rain or near water but avoid prolonged exposure or submersion in liquids other than fresh water.
- Ensure all ports are properly sealed before exposure.

### 3. Fast and Wireless Charging

- Supports Quick Charge 2.0 for rapid wired charging.
- Compatible with Qi wireless charging pads.
- To enable wireless charging, place the phone on a compatible charging mat.

### 4. Dual Pixel Camera Technology

- Provides faster autofocus and sharper images in low light.
- Use Pro Mode for manual control of ISO, shutter speed, and white balance.
- Enable HDR mode for better dynamic range in photos.

### 5. Secure Folder

- Create a private, encrypted space for apps and files.
- Access via **Settings** > **Lock screen and security** > **Secure Folder**.
- Requires Samsung account login and additional authentication.

### 6. Game Launcher

- Organizes games in one place.
- Provides options to block notifications and optimize performance during gaming sessions.

### 7. Edge Screen (if available)

- Swipe from the edge of the screen to access shortcuts, contacts, and tools.
- Customize edge panels via **Settings** > **Edge screen**.

### 8. Multi-window Mode

- Run two apps side by side for multitasking.
- Open recent apps, tap the app icon at the top, and select **Open in split screen view**.

---

## Maintenance and Care

Proper maintenance will keep your Samsung Galaxy S7 functioning optimally and extend its lifespan.

### Cleaning

1. Power off the device.
2. Use a microfiber cloth to gently wipe the screen and back cover.
3. For stubborn dirt, slightly dampen the cloth with water. Avoid using chemicals or abrasive materials.
4. Keep charging ports and speaker grills free of dust and debris.

### Battery Care

- Avoid letting the battery drain to 0% regularly; recharge between 20% and 80% for longer battery life.
- Use only Samsung-approved chargers and cables.
- Do not expose the phone to extreme temperatures.

### Software Updates

- Regularly check for software updates via **Settings** > **Software update** > **Download and install**.
- Updates improve security, fix bugs, and add new features.

### Protecting the Device

- Use a protective case and screen protector to prevent damage from drops and scratches.
- Avoid exposing the phone to liquids other than water and only for limited time, per IP68 rating.

### Storage Management

- Periodically clear cache and uninstall unused apps to free up space.
- Use the built-in **Device Maintenance** tool in **Settings** to optimize storage and system performance.

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem                       | Possible Cause                                   | Solution                                                                                   |
|------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Phone won't turn on           | Battery drained or software crash               | Charge the phone for at least 30 minutes, then press and hold Power button for 10 seconds. |
| Touchscreen unresponsive      | Software freeze or physical damage              | Restart the phone by holding Power + Volume Down buttons for 7 seconds.                     |
| Battery drains quickly        | Background apps running or old battery          | Close unused apps, reduce screen brightness, disable always-on display, or replace battery. |
| Cannot connect to Wi-Fi       | Incorrect password or router issue               | Restart router and phone, forget Wi-Fi network and reconnect with correct password.         |
| Calls drop frequently         | Poor signal or network congestion                | Move to an area with better coverage or switch between 3G/4G in Settings > Mobile networks. |
| Camera app crashes or lags    | Insufficient memory or corrupted app data       | Clear camera app cache via Settings > Apps > Camera > Storage > Clear Cache.                 |
| Phone overheats               | Heavy usage or faulty app                         | Close unused apps, remove case, avoid charging while using intensive apps.                   |
| Fingerprint sensor not working| Dirty sensor or software glitch                   | Clean sensor area, re-register fingerprint in Settings > Lock screen and security.          |

---

## Safety Information

Please read these safety instructions carefully to ensure safe and proper use of your Samsung Galaxy S7.

### Handling

- Avoid dropping or subjecting the phone to strong impacts.
- Do not attempt to disassemble or repair the device yourself.
- Keep the phone away from extreme heat, cold, and moisture.

### Charging

- Use only Samsung-approved chargers and cables.
- Do not charge the device near water or with wet hands.
- Avoid using damaged charging accessories.

### Battery Safety

- Do not puncture or expose the battery to fire.
- If the battery swells, leaks, or emits unusual odor, stop using the device and contact support.
- Dispose of batteries according to local regulations.

### Usage in Vehicles

- Do not use the phone while driving unless hands-free.
- Follow local laws regarding phone usage in cars.

### Medical Devices

- Maintain a distance of at least 15 cm between your phone and medical devices such as pacemakers.
- Consult a physician if you have concerns about interference.

### Water Resistance

- The Galaxy S7 is water-resistant but not waterproof.
- Avoid submerging the phone in salt water, chlorinated water, or liquids containing chemicals.
- Rinse and dry the phone immediately if it comes into contact with liquids.

### Children and Pets

- Keep the device and accessories out of reach of children and pets to prevent accidental damage or injury.

---

## Warranty and Support

### Warranty Coverage

- The Samsung Galaxy S7 comes with a **3 months limited warranty** from the date of purchase.
- The warranty covers manufacturing defects and hardware malfunctions under normal use.
- It does **not** cover accidental damage, water damage beyond IP68 limits, or unauthorized repairs.

### Warranty Service

- To make a warranty claim, provide proof of purchase and contact Samsung customer support.
- Service options may include repair, replacement, or refund at Samsung's discretion.

### Customer Support

- Visit Samsung's official support website for FAQs, manuals, software updates, and troubleshooting guides.
- Contact Samsung support via phone, email, or live chat for personalized assistance.
- Authorized service centers are available in many locations for in-person support.

### Shipping and Returns

- The product ships within 3-5 business days after order placement.
- Please note there is **no return policy** for the Samsung Galaxy S7, so ensure you are satisfied before purchase.

---

## FAQ

### 1. How do I take a screenshot on my Samsung Galaxy S7?

Press and hold the **Power** button and the **Home** button simultaneously for about 1-2 seconds. The screen will flash, and the screenshot will be saved to the Gallery app in the Screenshots folder.

### 2. Can I expand the storage on my Galaxy S7?

Yes, the Galaxy S7 supports microSD cards up to 256 GB. Insert the card into the SIM tray's second slot, and the phone will recognize it automatically.

### 3. How do I enable or disable Always On Display?

Go to **Settings** > **Display** > **Always On Display** and toggle it on or off. You can also customize the clock style and information shown.

### 4. What should I do if my phone is freezing or lagging?

Try restarting your phone by holding the Power button and tapping Restart. If the problem persists, clear app caches or perform a factory reset after backing up your data.

### 5. How can I improve battery life?

Reduce screen brightness, turn off Always On Display, close unused apps, disable Bluetooth and Wi-Fi when not in use, and avoid extreme temperatures.

### 6. Does the Galaxy S7 support fast charging?

Yes, it supports Quick Charge 2.0 via the included charger. Using Samsung's original charger ensures optimal charging speed.

### 7. How do I use the fingerprint sensor?

Go to **Settings** > **Lock Screen and Security** > **Fingerprints**, and follow the prompts to register your fingerprint. Use it to unlock the phone and authorize Samsung Pay or app logins.

### 8. Can I use my Galaxy S7 underwater?

The Galaxy S7 has an IP68 rating, meaning it can withstand submersion in up to 1.5 meters of fresh water for 30 minutes. Avoid salt water, chlorinated pools, or prolonged exposure.

### 9. How do I reset my Galaxy S7 to factory settings?

1. Back up your data.
2. Go to **Settings** > **Backup and Reset** > **Factory Data Reset**.
3. Confirm and wait for the process to complete. The phone will reboot as a new device.

### 10. What do I do if I forget my screen lock password?

Use Samsung's Find My Mobile service to unlock your phone remotely if you set it up beforehand, or perform a factory reset (this will erase all data).

---

This user guide aims to provide comprehensive assistance for your Samsung Galaxy S7. For further help, always refer to official Samsung resources or contact support. Enjoy your smartphone!

# Samsung Galaxy S8 User Guide

## Overview

The Samsung Galaxy S8 is a premium smartphone designed to deliver a stunning visual and user experience. Featuring Samsung's groundbreaking Infinity Display, the Galaxy S8 boasts a near bezel-less design that immerses you in vibrant, edge-to-edge visuals. This device is equipped with advanced camera technology that captures sharp, bright, and clear photos even in low-light conditions. Powered by cutting-edge hardware and software, the Galaxy S8 offers seamless multitasking, fast performance, and robust security features.

This guide provides you with comprehensive instructions on how to set up, operate, and maintain your Samsung Galaxy S8. Whether you are a new user or need to troubleshoot an issue, this manual will help you get the most out of your device.

---

## What's in the Box

When you purchase the Samsung Galaxy S8, your package includes the following items:

1. Samsung Galaxy S8 smartphone
2. USB Type-C charging cable
3. Fast charging power adapter
4. AKG-tuned wired earbuds with multiple ear tip sizes
5. SIM card ejector tool
6. Quick start guide and warranty card
7. USB connector (USB Type-C to USB Type-A adapter)
8. Micro USB connector (for data transfer)
9. Clear protective case (varies by region)
10. Screen protector (pre-applied or in-pack)

Please verify all items are present upon opening your package. If anything is missing, contact Samsung Support immediately.

---

## Specifications

| Feature               | Specification                   |
|-----------------------|--------------------------------|
| Model                 | Samsung Galaxy S8               |
| Display               | 5.8-inch Quad HD+ Super AMOLED Infinity Display (2960 x 1440 pixels) |
| Processor             | Exynos 8895 Octa-core (varies by region) or Qualcomm Snapdragon 835 |
| RAM                   | 4 GB                           |
| Storage               | 64 GB internal; expandable up to 256 GB via microSD card |
| Rear Camera           | 12 MP Dual Pixel with f/1.7 aperture, OIS, LED flash |
| Front Camera          | 8 MP with autofocus, f/1.7 aperture |
| Battery               | 3000 mAh, non-removable, Fast charging supported (wired and wireless) |
| Operating System      | Android 7.0 Nougat (upgradable) with Samsung Experience UI |
| Dimensions (cm)       | 23.05 x 26.88 x 15.73          |
| Weight                | 6 (assumed ounces, approx. 170 grams) |
| Connectivity          | Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 5.0, NFC, GPS, USB Type-C |
| Security Features     | Iris scanner, fingerprint sensor (rear-mounted), facial recognition |
| Audio                 | AKG-tuned stereo speakers, 3.5mm headphone jack |
| Warranty              | 2 years                       |

---

## Setup

Setting up your Samsung Galaxy S8 for the first time is easy. Follow these steps to get started:

1. **Insert the SIM Card and microSD Card (optional):**
   - Locate the SIM card tray on the top edge of the device.
   - Use the SIM ejector tool included in the box to open the tray.
   - Place your nano-SIM card into the tray, ensuring the metal contacts face down.
   - If you have a microSD card for extra storage, insert it into the second slot.
   - Carefully reinsert the tray into the phone until it clicks into place.

2. **Power On the Device:**
   - Press and hold the power button located on the right side of the phone until the Samsung logo appears.
   - Wait a few moments as the device boots up.

3. **Follow the On-Screen Setup Wizard:**
   - Select your preferred language and tap “Start.”
   - Connect to a Wi-Fi network by selecting your network name and entering the password.
   - Agree to the terms and conditions as prompted.
   - Sign in to your Google account or create one if you don't have it. This will allow access to the Google Play Store and synchronization of your data.
   - You can also sign in or create a Samsung account to access Samsung-specific services like Samsung Cloud and Galaxy Apps.
   - Set up security options such as PIN, password, pattern, fingerprint, or iris scanner.
   - Choose whether to restore apps and data from a previous device or start fresh.
   - Set up Samsung Pay if you wish to use your phone for contactless payments.

4. **Complete Setup:**
   - Customize preferences such as notifications, display settings, and voice assistant.
   - After setup, you will be taken to the home screen.

5. **Charge Your Device:**
   - Connect the USB Type-C cable to the phone and plug the charger into a power outlet.
   - The fast-charging feature allows your device to charge quickly; a full charge typically takes about 1.5 hours.

---

## Operation

This section covers the basic everyday operations of your Samsung Galaxy S8.

### Navigating the Interface

- **Home Screen:**
  - Swipe left or right to access different home panels.
  - Tap app icons to open applications.
  - Swipe up or down to access the app drawer.
  
- **Navigation Buttons:**
  - The Galaxy S8 uses on-screen navigation buttons:
    - **Back:** Returns to the previous screen.
    - **Home:** Returns to the home screen.
    - **Recent Apps:** Opens the list of recent apps for multitasking.

- **Notifications:**
  - Swipe down from the top of the screen to access notifications and quick settings.
  - Swipe down again to expand quick settings.
  - Swipe left or right on a notification to dismiss it.

### Making Calls

1. Open the **Phone** app from the home screen or app drawer.
2. Use the keypad to dial a number or select a contact.
3. Tap the green phone icon to initiate the call.
4. During a call, you can:
   - Mute/unmute your microphone.
   - Use speakerphone.
   - Access the keypad.
   - Add a call or start a conference call.
5. Tap the red phone icon to end the call.

### Messaging

- Open the **Messages** app.
- Tap the **+** icon to start a new message.
- Enter a contact name or phone number.
- Type your message in the text box.
- Tap the send icon (paper plane) to send your message.
- You can attach photos, videos, emojis, or voice notes by tapping the attachment icons.

### Camera Usage

- Open the **Camera** app.
- Switch between rear and front cameras via the camera switch icon.
- Tap the shutter button to take a photo.
- Tap and hold the shutter button to record a video.
- Use modes such as Pro, Panorama, Slow Motion, and Food by swiping through camera modes.
- Adjust settings like flash, timer, resolution, and filters from the camera settings menu.

### Internet and Connectivity

- Connect to Wi-Fi by swiping down the notification shade and tapping the Wi-Fi icon.
- Use mobile data through your SIM card.
- Enable Bluetooth to connect to accessories.
- Use NFC to make contactless payments or data transfers.

### Battery Saving Tips

- Use the built-in **Power Saving Mode** available in Settings > Device Maintenance > Battery.
- Lower screen brightness or enable adaptive brightness.
- Close unused apps running in the background.
- Turn off Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or GPS when not in use.

---

## Advanced Features

Samsung Galaxy S8 includes several advanced features to enhance your smartphone experience.

### Infinity Display

- The 5.8-inch Infinity Display extends from edge to edge, providing an immersive viewing experience.
- Adjust display settings in Settings > Display, including screen resolution, blue light filter, and screen timeout.
- Use split-screen multitasking by opening two apps simultaneously:
  1. Open the Recent Apps menu.
  2. Tap the app icon at the top of an app window.
  3. Select “Open in split screen view.”
  4. Choose the second app to display.

### Iris Scanner and Facial Recognition

- Set up biometric security under Settings > Lock Screen and Security.
- Use the iris scanner or facial recognition for quick and secure unlocking.
- For iris scanning:
  1. Hold the phone about 10-14 inches from your face.
  2. Look directly at the screen.
  3. Ensure good lighting for best results.

### Bixby Assistant

- Samsung's Bixby is an intelligent assistant that helps you perform tasks by voice, text, or touch.
- Access Bixby by pressing the dedicated Bixby button on the left side of the device or swiping right on the home screen.
- Bixby Voice allows you to send texts, open apps, set reminders, and more.
- Train Bixby to recognize your voice for improved accuracy.

### Samsung DeX

- The Galaxy S8 supports Samsung DeX, enabling a desktop-like experience when connected to a DeX Station or compatible dock.
- Connect your phone to an external monitor, keyboard, and mouse.
- Use apps in resizable windows and access a desktop interface.

### Wireless Charging

- The Galaxy S8 supports Qi-certified wireless charging.
- Place the phone on a compatible wireless charging pad to charge without cables.

### Water and Dust Resistance

- The device has IP68 certification, making it resistant to dust and water immersion up to 1.5 meters for 30 minutes.
- Avoid prolonged exposure to water and ensure all ports are dry before charging.

---

## Maintenance and Care

Proper maintenance ensures your Samsung Galaxy S8 stays in optimal condition.

### Cleaning

- Use a soft, lint-free cloth to clean the screen and body.
- Avoid using abrasive materials or harsh chemicals.
- If necessary, slightly dampen the cloth with water or a screen-safe cleaner.

### Battery Care

- Avoid letting your battery drain to 0% regularly.
- Charge your device before it reaches critically low levels.
- Use only Samsung-approved chargers and cables.
- Avoid exposing the phone to extreme temperatures.

### Software Updates

- Keep your device updated to benefit from security patches and new features.
- Check for updates in Settings > Software Update > Download and Install.
- Ensure you have sufficient battery and Wi-Fi connection before updating.

### Storage Management

- Clear cache regularly by going to Settings > Device Care > Storage.
- Uninstall unused apps to free up space.
- Use the microSD card slot to expand storage for media files.

### Physical Protection

- Use the included protective case or purchase a compatible case.
- Consider applying a tempered glass screen protector.
- Avoid dropping or exposing the device to impacts.

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem                          | Possible Cause                          | Solution                                                    |
|---------------------------------|---------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Phone won't turn on             | Battery drained or hardware issue     | Charge the phone for at least 30 minutes; try a forced restart by holding Power + Volume Down for 10 seconds. If still no response, contact support. |
| Touchscreen unresponsive        | Software glitch or screen damage      | Restart the phone; remove screen protector if interfering; perform a factory reset if problem persists. |
| Cannot make or receive calls    | Network issues or SIM card problem    | Check network coverage; remove and reinsert SIM card; try another SIM if available; reset network settings. |
| Wi-Fi won't connect             | Router issues or software error       | Restart router and phone; forget Wi-Fi network and reconnect; reset network settings. |
| Battery drains quickly          | Background apps or battery aging      | Close unused apps; disable unnecessary services; reduce screen brightness; check battery usage in settings; replace battery if aging. |
| Camera app crashes or freezes   | App cache or software bug              | Clear camera app cache; update software; restart phone; factory reset if necessary. |
| Phone overheating               | Heavy usage or software malfunction   | Close background apps; remove case; avoid charging while using; update software; seek service if overheating continues. |
| Fingerprint sensor not working  | Dirty sensor or hardware fault        | Clean the sensor with a soft cloth; re-register fingerprints; remove screen protector if it covers sensor; factory reset if software-related. |

---

## Safety Information

To ensure safe and effective use of your Samsung Galaxy S8, please observe the following precautions:

- **Battery Safety:** Use only Samsung-approved chargers and accessories. Do not expose the battery to heat or fire. Avoid puncturing or disassembling the battery.
- **Water Resistance:** While the phone is water and dust resistant (IP68), avoid prolonged exposure to water and do not charge the device when wet.
- **Hearing Safety:** Use headphones at moderate volume to prevent hearing damage.
- **Driving Safety:** Do not use the phone while driving unless using hands-free options.
- **Pacemakers and Medical Devices:** Maintain a minimum distance of 15 cm between the device and medical devices to avoid interference.
- **Explosive Environments:** Do not use the device near flammable gases or liquids.
- **Radio Frequency Exposure:** Use only with approved accessories to maintain compliance with RF exposure limits.
- **Device Repairs:** Do not attempt to disassemble or repair the phone yourself; seek authorized service providers.

---

## Warranty and Support

Your Samsung Galaxy S8 comes with a 2-year limited warranty that covers manufacturing defects and hardware failures under normal use conditions.

- **Warranty Coverage:**
  - Defects in materials or workmanship.
  - Hardware malfunctions excluding damage caused by misuse, accidents, or unauthorized repairs.

- **Warranty Exclusions:**
  - Physical damage such as cracks or water damage caused by improper use.
  - Software issues caused by third-party apps or unauthorized modifications.
  - Loss or theft of the device.

- **How to Obtain Warranty Service:**
  1. Contact Samsung Support via phone, chat, or email.
  2. Provide proof of purchase and a detailed description of the issue.
  3. Follow instructions for sending in the device or visiting an authorized service center.

- **Shipping and Returns:**
  - The Galaxy S8 ships within 1 week of order confirmation.
  - Please note that there is no return policy for this product. Ensure compatibility and satisfaction before purchase.

- **Additional Support:**
  - Visit the Samsung Support website for FAQs, user forums, and software downloads.
  - Use the Samsung Members app for diagnostics and live chat support.

---

## FAQ

**1. How do I take a screenshot on my Samsung Galaxy S8?**

To capture a screenshot, press and hold the Power button and the Volume Down button simultaneously for about 1-2 seconds. The screen will flash, and a thumbnail will appear, confirming the screenshot was taken. Screenshots are saved in the Gallery app under the “Screenshots” album.

---

**2. Can I use the Galaxy S8 with two SIM cards?**

The Galaxy S8 supports a single nano-SIM card. However, some regional variants offer a dual SIM model (called Galaxy S8 Dual SIM or S8+ Dual SIM). Check the packaging or Samsung's official website to confirm whether your model supports dual SIMs.

---

**3. How do I enable or disable the Always On Display?**

Go to Settings > Lock Screen and Security > Always On Display. Toggle the switch to enable or disable the feature. You can customize the clock style, notifications, and display mode on this screen.

---

**4. What should I do if my phone is frozen and unresponsive?**

Perform a forced restart by pressing and holding the Power and Volume Down buttons simultaneously for about 10 seconds until the phone restarts. This does not erase your data.

---

**5. How do I expand storage on the Galaxy S8?**

You can insert a microSD card of up to 256 GB in the SIM card tray. This expands your storage for photos, videos, and apps. Insert the card carefully with the phone powered off or on, and format it if prompted.

---

**6. How do I update my Galaxy S8 to the latest Android version?**

Navigate to Settings > Software Update > Download and Install. If an update is available, follow the on-screen instructions to download and install it. Ensure your battery is at least 50% charged and you have a stable Wi-Fi connection.

---

**7. How do I use Samsung Pay on the Galaxy S8?**

Samsung Pay allows you to make payments using your phone. To set it up:

1. Open the Samsung Pay app.
2. Sign in with your Samsung account.
3. Add your credit or debit cards by following the prompts.
4. To pay, swipe up from the home button, select a card, and authenticate using your fingerprint or PIN.

---

**8. What do I do if my fingerprint sensor is not working?**

Try the following:

- Clean the fingerprint sensor.
- Remove any screen protectors that might interfere.
- Delete and re-register your fingerprints in Settings > Lock Screen and Security > Fingerprints.
- If the problem persists, consider a factory reset or contact Samsung support.

---

Thank you for choosing the Samsung Galaxy S8. Enjoy your device and feel free to reach out to Samsung Support for any additional assistance.

The Samsung Galaxy Tab S8 Plus Grey is a cutting-edge Android tablet designed for users who demand a blend of power, portability, and premium display technology. Powered by a high-performance Qualcomm Snapdragon processor, the Tab S8 Plus offers smooth multitasking, fast app launches, and excellent gaming performance. ## Setup

Follow these steps to set up your Samsung Galaxy Tab S8 Plus Grey for the first time:

1. **Unpack your tablet and accessories.** Remove all packaging materials carefully.
2. **Charge your tablet.** Connect the USB-C cable to the tablet and the 45W charger to a power outlet. Charge the tablet fully before first use (approximately 2-3 hours).
3. **Power on the device.** Press and hold the power button on the top-right edge until the Samsung logo appears.
4. **Select your language and region.** Follow the on-screen prompts to choose your preferred language and region settings.
5. **Connect to Wi-Fi.** Choose your Wi-Fi network and enter the password to connect. You can skip this step temporarily but it is recommended for software updates.
6. **Sign in to your Samsung account.** Enter your Samsung account credentials or create an account to access Samsung services like Galaxy Store, Samsung Cloud, and Find My Mobile.
7. **Transfer data.** Optionally, use Samsung Smart Switch to transfer data from your old device (Android, iOS, or PC).
8. **Set up security.** Choose your preferred security method: fingerprint scanner, face recognition, PIN, pattern, or password.
9. **Install updates.** Check for and install any available software updates for security and performance improvements.
10. **Configure S Pen.** When prompted, pair your S Pen via Bluetooth by holding the button on the pen near the tablet. You can customize pen settings in the Samsung Notes app.
11. **Complete setup.** Finish the guided setup to start using your tablet.

---

## Operation

### Basic Navigation

- **Home Screen:** Swipe up from the bottom to access the home screen. Use the navigation bar or gestures depending on your preference.
- **App Drawer:** Swipe up on the home screen to reveal all installed apps.
- **Notifications Panel:** Swipe down from the top to view notifications and quick settings.
- **Multitasking:** Tap the recent apps button or swipe up and hold to switch between apps.
- **Split Screen:** Open an app, then tap the recent apps button and select the split screen icon to run two apps simultaneously.
- **S Pen Usage:** Hover the S Pen over the screen to preview content. Tap to select or write/draw directly on the screen.

### Common Tasks

- **Adjust Brightness:** Swipe down to open Quick Settings, then adjust the brightness slider.
- **Volume Control:** Use the physical volume buttons on the side or adjust in Quick Settings.
- **Taking Screenshots:** Press and hold the power button and volume down button simultaneously. Alternatively, use the S Pen Air Command menu to capture screen.
- **Access Samsung Notes:** Tap the Samsung Notes app icon to create handwritten notes, sketches, or convert handwriting to text.
- **Use DeX Mode:** Connect to an external monitor or use the tablet itself in desktop mode by enabling DeX from Quick Settings.
- **Download Apps:** Open Galaxy Store or Google Play Store to browse and install apps.
- **Voice Assistant:** Press and hold the home button or say “Hi Bixby” to activate Samsung's voice assistant for commands.

---

## Advanced Features

### Samsung S Pen

- **Low Latency Writing:** The S Pen offers near real-time writing response, perfect for note-taking and drawing.
- **Air Actions:** Use gestures with the S Pen button pressed to control media, switch apps, or navigate presentations.
- **Screen Off Memo:** Double-tap the screen with the S Pen when the tablet is locked to quickly jot down notes.
- **Smart Select:** Capture specific parts of the screen and create GIFs or annotations.
- **Translate Text:** Hover the S Pen over text to highlight and translate words or sentences instantly.

### Samsung DeX

- **Desktop Experience:** Connect your tablet to an external display or use the tablet screen in DeX mode to run multiple resizable windows, drag and drop files, and access a taskbar.
- **Keyboard and Mouse Support:** Pair Bluetooth or USB keyboards and mice for a full desktop-like experience.
- **File Management:** Use the My Files app to organize documents, images, and downloads efficiently.

### Connectivity and Sharing

- **5G Connectivity:** (If cellular model) Enjoy fast internet speeds with built-in 5G support.
- **Wi-Fi 6E:** Connect to advanced Wi-Fi networks for higher throughput and lower latency.
- **Bluetooth 5.2:** Connect wireless headphones, speakers, and accessories with improved range and stability.
- **Samsung Flow:** Seamlessly transfer files and sync notifications between your Galaxy Tab and other Samsung devices.
- **Link to Windows:** Sync your tablet with a Windows PC to receive notifications, reply to messages, and access photos without picking up your phone.

### Camera and Video

- **Rear Camera:** Use the 13 MP wide and 6 MP ultra-wide lenses to capture high-resolution photos and 4K video.
- **Front Camera:** Ideal for video calls and selfies with a 12 MP ultra-wide lens.
- **Single Take Mode:** Capture multiple photos and videos with one tap, then choose the best shots.
- **Night Mode:** Enhance low-light photos with software-based brightness and noise reduction.
- **Video Editing:** Use built-in Gallery app tools to trim, filter, and enhance videos.

---

## Maintenance and Care

To keep your Samsung Galaxy Tab S8 Plus Grey in optimal condition, follow these guidelines:

1. **Cleaning the Device:**
   - Use a soft, lint-free microfiber cloth to clean the screen and body.
   - Avoid using harsh chemicals, alcohol-based cleaners, or abrasive materials.
   - For stubborn smudges, lightly dampen the cloth with water or a screen-safe cleaner.
2. **Protecting the Screen:**
   - The tablet comes with a pre-applied protective film; consider applying an additional tempered glass protector.
   - Always use the supplied S Pen or compatible accessories to avoid scratches.
3. **Battery Care:**
   - Avoid letting the battery discharge completely before charging.
   - Use the included 45W charger or certified chargers to prevent damage.
   - Do not expose the tablet to extreme temperatures (below 0°C or above 35°C).
4. **Storage:**
   - Store the tablet in a cool, dry place when not in use.
   - Avoid placing heavy objects on top of the tablet.
5. **Software Maintenance:**
   - Regularly check for and install software updates to keep your system secure and efficient.
   - Restart the tablet occasionally to clear background processes.
6. **S Pen Maintenance:**
   - Keep the S Pen tip clean and free from debris.
   - If the tip wears down, replacement tips are available from Samsung.
7. **Physical Protection:**
   - Consider purchasing a Samsung-branded case or cover to protect against drops and impacts.
   - Avoid exposing the tablet to water or excessive moisture as it is not rated as waterproof.

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem                       | Possible Cause                                         | Solution                                                  |
|------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| Tablet won't power on         | Battery is completely drained                          | Connect to charger and charge for at least 30 minutes     |
| Screen unresponsive           | Software glitch or system freeze                       | Hold power button + volume down for 10 seconds to reboot  |
| S Pen not connecting          | Bluetooth disabled or S Pen battery depleted          | Enable Bluetooth, replace S Pen battery if needed, re-pair|
| Wi-Fi not connecting          | Incorrect password or router issue                     | Re-enter password, restart router, toggle Wi-Fi on tablet|
| Apps crashing or freezing     | Outdated apps or insufficient RAM                      | Update apps, close background apps, restart tablet        |
| Battery draining quickly      | High screen brightness or running multiple apps       | Lower brightness, close unused apps, check battery usage  |
| No sound from speakers        | Volume muted or software error                          | Increase volume, disable Do Not Disturb, restart device   |
| Tablet overheating            | Intensive tasks or environmental heat                  | Close heavy apps, avoid direct sunlight, remove case if hot|
| Unable to install apps        | Insufficient storage or incompatible OS version       | Free up storage space, check app compatibility            |
| Camera app not opening        | Software error or permissions issue                     | Restart tablet, check app permissions in settings         |

---

## Safety Information

Your safety and the longevity of your Samsung Galaxy Tab S8 Plus depend on following these precautions:

- **Use only Samsung-approved chargers and accessories** to avoid damage or injury.
- **Keep the tablet dry and away from liquids.** It is not waterproof and moisture can cause malfunction.
- **Do not expose to extreme temperatures.** Operating or charging in hot or cold environments can damage the battery.
- **Avoid dropping or striking the tablet**, which can damage internal components or the display.

## FAQ

# Samsung Galaxy Tab White User Guide

## Overview

The Samsung Galaxy Tab White is a sleek and versatile Android tablet designed to meet your everyday digital needs. Featuring a vibrant display, a robust processor, and a long-lasting battery, this tablet is perfect for browsing the web, streaming videos, reading eBooks, gaming, and productivity tasks. Its compact and lightweight design makes it highly portable, fitting comfortably in your hand or bag.

Whether you are a student, professional, or casual user, the Galaxy Tab White offers a smooth and intuitive user experience powered by the latest Android operating system and Samsung's optimized software. Its white finish adds a modern, clean aesthetic that complements any environment.

This guide provides comprehensive instructions to help you set up, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot your Samsung Galaxy Tab White. It also includes important safety information and details about your warranty and support options.

---

## What's in the Box

When you purchase the Samsung Galaxy Tab White, you will receive the following items inside the package:

1. Samsung Galaxy Tab White tablet
2. USB Type-C charging cable
3. Wall charger adapter (15W fast charging)
4. Quick Start Guide (includes warranty information)

Please verify all items are included and undamaged before use. If you find any missing or defective components, contact Samsung support or the retailer immediately.

---

## Specifications

| Feature                 | Description                                  |
|-------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| Model Name              | Samsung Galaxy Tab White                      |
| Operating System        | Android 12 (upgradable to Android 13)        |
| Display                 | 10.1-inch TFT LCD, 1920 x 1200 pixels, 224 ppi |
